en: Real-photo postcard showing a studio portrait of six young male musicians in formal suits, holding violins and a double bass. Handwritten numbers mark each person on the front. The reverse has a handwritten list of names corresponding to the numbers and a note identifying them as a high school orchestra with the year 1916. There is also a museum stamp reading MUZEUL JUD. Bv. and an accession number.
